verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an in-product assistant is a one-line pricing-page entry for a 'Conversational meeting assistant'. Alongside it are fixed AI automations: summaries, action items, AI scorecards and automatic CRM field updates. The MCP server and Claude connector bring Fathom data into external assistants, so they do not count as a built-in assistant here. Missing for 10: documentation of what tasks the built-in assistant can carry out, evidence that it takes multi-step actions rather than just answering questions, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
